verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents several background-automation primitives — Snowpipe auto-ingests files without manual scheduling, Streams capture DML changes so actions can be taken automatically, and 'CREATE OR ALTER DYNAMIC TABLE' auto-refreshes transformations — plus a Cortex Agents/MCP server that lets AI agents pull data autonomously. However, there is no explicit documentation of Snowflake's Task/scheduling object for orchestrating multi-step autonomous jobs, and no first-party or hands-on evidence of an AI-native user actually wiring these primitives into a persistent background agent loop. missing for 10: explicit Tasks/scheduling docs, an end-to-end example of an AI agent autonomously orchestrating pipeline steps, and independent confirmation of this working in practice.
